title: What Is CallPutCrypto? I’m Building an AI Crypto Price Prediction & Market Analysis Platform
author: dvysrm
selftext:
CallPutCrypto is an ongoing project I’m building around **AI crypto market analysis, price predictions and short-term cryptocurrency forecasts**.

It combines live crypto prices, technical indicators, market news and AI-generated signals into individual analysis pages for different cryptocurrencies.

I’m particularly focused on multi-timeframe analysis, so the platform can compare short-term movements with larger market trends instead of relying on one signal.

It’s still actively being developed. I’m adding more assets, improving the prediction and signal models, refining the analysis and experimenting with different ways to make crypto research easier.

The goal is to eventually make CallPutCrypto a useful place for **crypto price forecasts, technical analysis and AI market signals** without pretending that anyone can predict the market perfectly.

Still a work in progress, but it’s getting better every week.
